The '''Rajah''' was the ruling monarch of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Virujansi/Legends|Virujansi]]. The Rajah maintained a [[Royal Court]], staffed with advisors. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Rajah was targeted by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], but the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] learned of the operation and spirited the Rajah and Royal Court to safety. Posing as the Rajah and his court, an Alliance team purposely got themselves incarcerated on the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Captivity]] to rescue political prisoners.
